A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the B-MAD688 antibody is an important new tool to study human pro-B cell biology.
the psi L complex is not only expressed intracellularly but it is also present on the cell surface.
B-MAD688 recognizes a novel surface marker on human pro-B cells, and that it can be used to distinguish between different forms of surrogate Ig receptors on the surface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Vpre-B protein is a useful antigen for the development of antibodies that can recognize and isolate the surrogate immunoglobulin complex from pro-B cell lines or from normal bone marrow cells.
the B-MAD688 antibody can be used to identify pro-B cells in human bone marrow samples, and that the antibody can be used for flow cytometry and immunoprecipitation experiments.
the Vpre-B protein can be used as a marker for the early B cell development in humans.
